data.narrative:
Anthro Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Jonathan Hes, David Mackanic, and Joe Papp. The target sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. The company has raised $53.3M to date.

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable valuation method. Using total capital raised ($53M) as a proxy for Series A valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $107M. Peer-median comparison was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Climate & Energy sector; while eight sector peers exist, none satisfied the narrow filtering criteria required for reliable triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $91M (low) to $123M (high), with a median point of $107M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodology rather than independent triangulation. Key uncertainties include the absence of recent same-stage transaction data in the subsector and the heterogeneity of Climate & Energy business models, which limits peer applicability. Any valuation within this band remains contingent on further diligence regarding Anthro's unit economics, technology differentiation, and market timing relative to the peer set.
